metadata.question: Does Dorsoidong Co Lake have a lighter blue color than Chibzhang Co Lake in October 12, 1987?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare the color (blue reflectance) of two lakes on a specific date (October 12, 1987). 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: Landsat 5 (operational 1984-2013, perfect for 1987) - Bands: Blue band (B1 for Landsat 5) - Date: 1987-10-12 (specific date requested) - Location: Two lakes in Tibet (Dorsoidong Co and Chibzhang Co) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Need to mask clouds to get clear water pixels - Use QA band for cloud masking - Focus on water bodies only 3. **Logic**: - Extract mean blue reflectance for each lake - Compare values - higher reflectance = lighter color - Handle cases where data is missing or invalid Let me define the coordinates for the lakes: - Dorsoidong Co: ~33.1°N, 88.1°E - Chibzhang Co: ~33.5°N, 88.5°E I'll use Landsat 5 Collection 2 Tier 1, which has proper cloud masking via the QA_PIXEL band. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define lake geometries (points with buffers) const dorsoidongCo = ee.Geometry.Point([88.1, 33.1]).buffer(500); const chibzhangCo = ee.Geometry.Point([88.5, 33.5]).buffer(500); // Function to mask clouds and water function maskCloudsAndWater(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); // Cloud bit const cloudShadowMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0); // Cloud shadow bit // Water mask (NDWI > 0) const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); return image.updateMask(cloudMask.and(cloudShadowMask).and(waterMask)) .addBands(ndwi); } // Get Landsat 5 collection for the specific date const startDate = '1987-10-12'; const endDate = '1987-10-13'; const landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dorsoidongCo.union(chibzhangCo)) .map(maskCloudsAndWater); // Check if collection is empty const colSize = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { print("No Landsat 5 images found for 1987-10-12"); print("C1"); return; } // Get the first image const image = landsatCol.first(); // Extract blue band (B1) reflectance for both lakes const blueBand = 'SR_B1'; // Calculate mean blue reflectance for Dorsoidong Co const dorsoidongStats = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: dorsoidongCo, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Calculate mean blue reflectance for Chibzhang Co const chibzhangStats = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chibzhangCo, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const dorsoidongMean = dorsoidongStats.get('mean').getInfo(); const dorsoidongCount = dorsoidongStats.get('count').getInfo(); const chibzhangMean = chibzhangStats.get('mean').getInfo(); const chibzhangCount = chibzhangStats.get('count').getInfo(); print(`Dorsoidong Co: Mean Blue=${dorsoidongMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${dorsoidongCount}`); print(`Chibzhang Co: Mean Blue=${chibzhangMean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${chibzhangCount}`); // Check for valid pixels if (dorsoidongCount === 0 || chibzhangCount === 0) { print("No valid water pixels after masking"); print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (dorsoidongMean === null || chibzhangMean === null || isNaN(dorsoidongMean) || isNaN(chibzhangMean)) { print("Calculation failed - invalid reflectance values"); print("C3"); return; } // Compare blue reflectance (higher = lighter color) if (dorsoidongMean > chibzhangMean) { print("Dorsoidong Co is lighter (higher blue reflectance)"); print("A"); } else { print("Chibzhang Co is lighter or equal (higher/equal blue reflectance)"); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
